questions.stem: According to Newton's Third Law, if you push a wall with 50 N, the wall pushes back on you with:
questions.explanation: Newton's Third Law states that for every action there is an equal and opposite reaction. If you push the wall with 50 N, the wall pushes back on you with exactly 50 N in the opposite direction.

questions.stem: Why don't Newton's Third Law force pairs cancel each other out?

options.text: One force is always slightly larger
One is a real force and one is imaginary

questions.explanation: Third Law force pairs act on DIFFERENT objects, so they cannot cancel out. Forces can only cancel when they act on the SAME object. For example, when you push a wall, one force acts on the wall and the other acts on you.
